seed_intent: Extend PMCRO.Mcp.Terminal to fully implement all three MCP pillars: Tools (exists), Resources, and Prompts
key_knowledge_extracted: MCP C# SDK 1.3.0 attribute-based discovery is symmetric for all three pillars — WithToolsFromAssembly, WithResourcesFromAssembly, WithPromptsFromAssembly.
TextResourceContents is the correct concrete return type for resource methods.
McpServerPrompt with IEnumerable<ChatMessage> is the multi-turn prompt pattern.
ServerInfo + ServerInstructions set on AddMcpServer() are sent during client init handshake.
Static ConcurrentDictionary shared between TerminalTools and TerminalResources is correct for in-process session-scoped history.
terminal://skill resource implements Progressive Disclosure — SKILL.md travels with the server, not the client.
